title: Lecture-only quiz
description: Interim prediction: 20 questions chosen automatically from the bank by coverage tag (lecture-only or lecture+book), four per chapter, lecture-only material first and then the highest-likelihood lecture topics. Chapter 5 was barely reached in class, so its four questions overlap the lecture + book quiz.

title: Lecture + book quiz (primary prediction)
description: Interim prediction: 20 questions grounded in both the lecture and the corresponding book material (coverage lecture+book), four per chapter, keeping the earlier hand-picked prediction and filling chapter 5 from the bank. The most accurate reflection of testable material until the hand-built version replaces it.

title: Book-only quiz
description: Interim prediction: 20 questions drawn entirely from the assigned chapters on material the lecture did not reach (coverage book-only), four per chapter, highest likelihood first.
